label: Decides through physics: MLP -> WaterSim HBV parameters, trained through the simulator + Mondrian conformal
numpy_only_reason: wraps tab_dpl: The prediction IS a WaterSim run: predict.py maps attributes to parameters with a numpy MLP and then calls the harness's vendored WaterSim (numba-compiled HBV + degree-day snow + gamma channel UH + irrigation) through wsim.py. Re-writing WaterSim in numpy would duplicate the simulator the arm is meant to use.

compute.notes: conformal fit only (dev predictions of tab_dpl + shifts); the base arm is not retrained

feature_engineering: none beyond tab_dpl's; the conformal offset uses static[11] (mean forcing P) and the class list (strata)
rule: No ladder: one conformal fit on dev residuals (method fixed in advance). Reported raw vs conformal.

rungs.change: Mondrian split-conformal bands (asymmetric CQR, log space, strata snow/arid/humid/other) fitted on dev residuals
rungs.why: the only rung; dev coverage (LOBO) ungauged 0.93
